title: India can achieve 600 MT steel capacity by 2047: Naveen Jindal
dek: Naveen Jindal says India can achieve 600 MT of steel capacity by 2047, according to IANS LIVE.
summary: According to IANS LIVE, Naveen Jindal has said India can achieve 600 MT of steel capacity by 2047. The publisher's excerpt does not explain the basis for the projection or what conditions would be required.
keyFacts: India can achieve 600 MT steel capacity by 2047, according to Naveen Jindal
whyItMatters: The projection from a senior industry figure underlines long-term ambitions for capacity expansion in India. Expansion on that scale would have large implications for raw-material demand and investment.
implications: Suppliers of iron ore, coal and equipment may see sustained long-term demand if such expansion materialises. Readers should treat this as a projection rather than a plan.
